method: view_image on the actual on-disk original PNG and proportional 360/680 inspection PNGs, all original detail; actual visual reading and counting
observedFindings: Both rows contain exactly five aligned positions; only position 3 differs, G versus A.
There are no complementary-strand rungs joining the compared variants, and neither row claims a diploid genotype.
The measurement motif has a question mark instead of an automatic acceptance stamp; dotted division and colored dots remain a qualitative inspection cue, not a QC threshold or cohort.
Marker ≠ Diagnose and the not-equal symbol remain clearly legible at 360/680; the ten actual base letters remain readable.
limitations: The aligned sequence excerpts compare variants, not two complementary strands of one DNA molecule.
The handful of qualitative dots supplies no genotype call, minimum molecule count, validated assay or population association.
No clinical sensitivity, specificity, causal conclusion or disease diagnosis is claimed.
altTextDe: Zwei getrennte gleich orientierte DNA-Ausschnitte zeigen A C G T A und A C A T A. Nur die dritte Base ist unterschiedlich und gemeinsam markiert. Eine Lupe mit Fragezeichen steht für Messqualität; darunter steht Marker ungleich Diagnose.
altTextEn: Two separate equally oriented DNA excerpts show A C G T A and A C A T A. Only the third base differs and is jointly highlighted. A magnifier and question mark represent measurement quality; below, marker is not equal to diagnosis.
formatDecision: native 1672x941 landscape, near 16:9; major motifs and essential labels actually visible at both widths
